sources.use: Pattern taxonomy and preservation-first review concepts; no upstream executable or automatic rewriter is run.
Lexical and structural warning concepts selected for technical and academic prose; the full Vale package is not applied mechanically.
High-confidence conversational, puffery and generic-conclusion pattern concepts; social-media-specific rules are excluded.

rules.pattern: \b(?:certainly|absolutely)[!,]|\b(?:great|excellent) question[!,]|\blet(?:'|’)s (?:delve|explore|break (?:this|it) down)\b|\bi hope this helps\b|\bfeel free to ask\b
rules.message: Conversational assistant wording is inappropriate in a journal manuscript.
rules.guidance: Delete the interactional phrase and begin with the scientific claim or evidence.

rules.message: Generic landscape framing delays the research problem.
rules.guidance: Open with the specific empirical, technical or theoretical problem and cite its evidence.

rules.message: The sentence announces importance instead of demonstrating it.
rules.guidance: Replace the valuation with the measured contribution, comparison and uncertainty.

rules.pattern: \bthe future (?:looks|is) (?:bright|promising)\b|\bonly time will tell\b|\bthe possibilities are endless\b|\b(?:paves?|opens?) the way for (?:future|further) (?:research|innovation|advances?)\b
rules.message: The conclusion is generic and not tied to the reported evidence.
rules.guidance: End with the bounded result, limitation and next falsifiable research step.

rules.message: The attribution is too vague to audit.
rules.guidance: Name and cite the relevant evidence, or state the proposition as an explicitly bounded inference.

rules.pattern: \b(?:it is (?:important|crucial|essential|worthwhile) to (?:note|mention|emphasize) that|it should be noted that|in order to|due to the fact that|for the purpose of)\b
rules.message: Filler or metadiscourse obscures the substantive statement.
rules.guidance: State the fact, method or limitation directly without changing its evidential force.

rules.message: Multiple nearby hedges make the uncertainty boundary unclear.
rules.guidance: Retain the single scientifically justified qualifier and state the source of uncertainty.

rules.message: Absolute certainty is rarely justified by empirical evidence.
rules.guidance: Calibrate the claim to the design, estimand, uncertainty interval and external-validity limits.

rules.message: A performance claim is not quantified in the matched wording.
rules.guidance: Report the comparison, effect size or absolute difference, uncertainty and multiplicity treatment where applicable.

rules.message: The novelty language is stronger than a manuscript should assert without a current closest-work audit.
rules.guidance: State the exact residual contribution relative to named closest work and preserve the remaining novelty risk.

rules.message: A trailing participle may be substituting interpretation for a supported analytical link.
rules.guidance: Specify what result supports the interpretation, or remove the trailing evaluative clause.

rules.message: A stock binary contrast may overstate the distinction.
rules.guidance: State the precise distinction, comparison or mechanism directly.

rules.message: A rhetorical question opens a section or paragraph instead of stating the research problem.
rules.guidance: State the research question or problem formally and connect it to evidence or a registered hypothesis.
